description:
This document exists to be the other half of a test. It is written the way a person writes JSON — members in a different order, some arguments in the object form and some in the string form, the options listed the other way round — and it describes the same commands as the built-in sample profile. Resolving both produces the same Command, and `Command.Digest` says so.

That equality is the whole extension model in one assertion. If a built-in profile ever gains a privileged path, this is the test that stops compiling.
